allowed.description: Whether the organisation's allowlist names it now.

id.description: The app's client ID: its name on the allowlist for a first-party app, mcp-… for one that registered itself.

publisher.description: The publisher Fyniq has verified; absent for an app that registered itself, which Fyniq has not verified.

status.description: first_party: pre-registered by the release; the others are a self-registered app's course.

verified.description: Whether Fyniq verified who publishes it: only the apps the release pre-registered.
